icons.name: File
icons.note: Cut corner sits top-LEFT with no fold line — the inverse of the usual folded-page glyph.

icons.name: New File
icons.note: Page + centred accent plus; page silhouette is the Frontier cut-corner document.

icons.name: Code File
icons.note: Angle brackets rendered as two open 90° hooks inside the cut-corner page.

icons.name: Data File
icons.note: Braces-in-page is a common concept; the brace here is a single-stroke S-curve, tighter than typical curly-brace icons.

icons.name: Image File
icons.note: Mountain-in-frame is universal; differentiated by the cut-corner page and an offset accent sun dot.

icons.name: Markdown File
icons.note: Monogram M + down-arrow (the Markdown mark) rebuilt as a chamfered M, not the usual rounded one.

icons.name: Folder
icons.note: Folder silhouette is unavoidable; the tab joint is a 45° ramp and body corners are cut, not rounded.

icons.name: Open Folder
icons.note: Open state drawn as a slanted front flap overlapping an open-backed shell — no lid swing.

icons.name: New Folder
icons.note: Folder + plus; plus is the accent layer so it can carry the brand colour.

icons.name: Save
icons.note: Deliberately NOT a floppy disk: a page with an accent arrow driving into a baseline slot.

icons.name: Save All
icons.note: Stacked pages share one accent arrow — reads as "many files, one write".

icons.name: Close File
icons.note: Page + x; the x is accent-coloured so destructive/dismiss intent is tintable.

icons.name: Duplicate File
icons.note: Two cut-corner pages offset on the diagonal with the back page reduced to an echo stroke.

icons.name: Delete
icons.note: Bin glyph is universal; body is a tapered cut-corner can with accent ribs.

icons.name: File Tree
icons.note: Hierarchy drawn as chamfered "tag" nodes on a spine, not indented lines.

icons.name: Left Panel
icons.note: Pane layout icons are inherently generic; the frame is a cut-corner octagon and the active pane is a tint fill.

icons.name: Right Panel
icons.note: Mirror of Left Panel; tint marks the active pane.

icons.name: Bottom Panel
icons.note: Same octagon frame family; horizontal divider with tinted lower pane.

icons.name: Hide Panel
icons.note: Frame with an accent x sitting on the divider — "the pane goes away".

icons.name: Split Right
icons.note: Divider + chevron; the chevron is accent so the "push" direction is tintable.

icons.name: Split Down
icons.note: Vertical twin of Split Right.

icons.name: Workspace
icons.note: Three-pane IDE silhouette with a tinted centre editor — reads as a workbench, not a window.

icons.name: Tab
icons.note: Tab drawn as a trapezoid with a 45° left ramp sitting on a rail — no rounded-top tab.

icons.name: Close Tab
icons.note: Tab + accent x.

icons.name: All Tabs
icons.note: Two nested tab ramps suggest a stack without drawing stacked rectangles.

icons.name: Pin
icons.note: Pushpin is universal; head is a cut-corner block and the needle is the accent layer.

icons.name: Collapse Sidebar
icons.note: Divider with an accent arrow folding INTO the edge — direction is explicit.

icons.name: Window
icons.note: Title-bar window is generic; traffic dots are accent fills and the frame is cut-cornered.

icons.name: Archive
icons.note: Lidded box; lid is a wide cut-corner band rather than a rounded rect.

icons.name: Locked
icons.note: Padlock is universal; shackle is squared with cut shoulders to match the family.

icons.name: Unlocked
icons.note: Open-shackle padlock; same family body.

icons.name: Undo
icons.note: Undo arrow is universal; the hook here is a 45° corner instead of a full semicircle.

icons.name: Redo
icons.note: Mirror of Undo.

icons.name: Cut
icons.note: Scissors are unavoidable; blades cross at a steeper 60° and handles are cut-corner rings, not circles.

icons.name: Copy
icons.note: Two-page copy is universal; both pages carry the cut corner and the back page is an echo stroke.

icons.name: Paste
icons.note: Clipboard is universal; board is cut-cornered and the clip is a squared bridge.

icons.name: Select All
icons.note: Selection drawn as four detached corner brackets (a marching-ants abstraction), not a solid rect.

icons.name: Find
icons.note: Magnifier is the most universal glyph in UI; differentiation: lens is a cut-corner OCTAGON, handle at 45°.

icons.name: Find (text)
icons.note: Alternative search with zero magnifier: a page whose lines are interrupted by a highlighted run.

icons.name: Find & Replace
icons.note: Two text runs with a swap arrow between; the incoming run is tinted to show the substitution target.

icons.name: Find in Files
icons.note: Octagon lens sweeping two stacked pages.

icons.name: Line Numbers
icons.note: Gutter rule with tick digits abstraction: short ticks left of long text lines.

icons.name: Increase Indent
icons.note: Indent arrows are standard; the pushed line carries an accent chevron.

icons.name: Decrease Indent
icons.note: Mirror of Increase Indent.

icons.name: Toggle Comment
icons.note: Two code lines each slashed at 45° by one continuous accent stroke — literal "commented out".

icons.name: Word Wrap
icons.note: Wrap arrow bending under a line; bend is a cut corner rather than a curve.

icons.name: Format Document
icons.note: Ragged lines snapped to a shared accent baseline tick — shows the result, not a wand.

icons.name: Sort Lines
icons.note: Three lines of decreasing length with a descending accent arrow alongside.

icons.name: Delete Line
icons.note: A line struck through with an accent x-slash while its neighbours survive.

icons.name: Move Line Up
icons.note: Line + up arrow; the moving line is accent to distinguish actor from context.

icons.name: Move Line Down
icons.note: Mirror of Move Line Up.

icons.name: Multi Cursor
icons.note: Three I-beam carets staggered — no other common set shows plural carets.

icons.name: Column Selection
icons.note: A tinted block with corner nubs — the box-selection rectangle made tangible.

icons.name: Fold
icons.note: Chevron-into-bracket; bracket is cut-cornered.

icons.name: Unfold
icons.note: Mirror of Fold.

icons.name: Fold All
icons.note: Double chevron stacked into a bracket pair.

icons.name: Unfold All
icons.note: Mirror of Fold All.

icons.name: Bookmark
icons.note: Ribbon bookmark is universal; tail is cut as a double 45° notch instead of a V.

icons.name: Snippet
icons.note: A cut-corner page with a bite taken out (dashed gap) where the snippet slots in.

icons.name: Text Cursor
icons.note: I-beam; serifs are angled cuts rather than horizontal bars.

icons.name: Highlight
icons.note: Marker pen at 45°; the ink trail is the tint layer.

icons.name: Rename / Edit
icons.note: Pencil is universal; ferrule is a cut band and the tip is accent.

icons.name: Code
icons.note: Angle brackets are universal; the slash between them is a steep accent diagonal, not the usual gentle one.

icons.name: Braces
icons.note: Brace glyph is standard; drawn as one continuous S-curve per side with pointed waist.

icons.name: Brackets
icons.note: Square brackets with 45° cut outer corners — the family chamfer applied to punctuation.

icons.name: Parentheses
icons.note: Parenthesis arcs; kept pure since the curve IS the glyph.

icons.name: Terminal
icons.note: Prompt-in-frame is universal; frame is the cut-corner octagon and the prompt is accent.

icons.name: Function
icons.note: Italic ƒ built from one descending stem with a top hook; crossbar is the accent layer.

icons.name: Variable
icons.note: An x with an assignment dash — reads as "x =" without letterforms.

icons.name: Class
icons.note: UML class box: cut-corner frame, header rule, accent type name.

icons.name: Interface
icons.note: A dashed contract frame around a solid accent core — "shape without body".

icons.name: Database
icons.note: Cylinder is universal; the middle ring is accent so "data level" is tintable.

icons.name: API
icons.note: Two-way exchange arrows inside brackets — request/response instead of a cloud.

icons.name: Regex
icons.note: Literal ".*" — a six-ray asterisk over two accent dots. No other set ships this.

icons.name: Constant
icons.note: A hash whose horizontals are accent and verticals lean — reads as # and as "fixed value".

icons.name: String
icons.note: Open-quote pair drawn as two tapered commas, oversized so they read at 16px.

icons.name: Module
icons.note: Isometric cube is standard for packages; top face is tinted.

icons.name: Command Palette
icons.note: Frame with prompt chevron, a typed token and a suggestion line — a palette in miniature.

icons.name: Extension
icons.note: Plug glyph; body is a cut-corner bowl and the cord is accent.

icons.name: Run
icons.note: Play triangle with a cut leading edge; accent so "go" can be green in-app.

icons.name: Build
icons.note: Hammer head is a cut-corner block on an accent handle.

icons.name: Test
icons.note: Flask with cut shoulders; liquid line is accent.

icons.name: Bold
icons.note: B rebuilt as two stacked cut-corner bowls on a shared spine — no round counters.

icons.name: Italic
icons.note: Slanted I with serifs; the slant angle matches the family 45°.

icons.name: Underline
icons.note: U + rule; the U base is a cut corner instead of an arc.

icons.name: Strikethrough
icons.note: Two text rows pierced by one continuous accent rule.

icons.name: Heading
icons.note: H with an accent rank digit drawn as a single flag stroke.

icons.name: Bullet List
icons.note: Bullets are accent squares (cut corners) rather than dots.

icons.name: Numbered List
icons.note: Micro-numerals 1-2-3 drawn with hairline accent strokes beside ink rows.

icons.name: Task List
icons.note: Cut-corner checkboxes; the done tick is accent, the open box is ink.

icons.name: Quote
icons.note: Accent gutter bar + two tapered quote commas.

icons.name: Link
icons.note: Chain link is universal; the connecting strand is the accent layer.

icons.name: Insert Image
icons.note: Frame + ridge + sun; frame is the cut-corner octagon.

icons.name: Insert Table
icons.note: Grid in the octagon frame; header row is tinted.

icons.name: Divider
icons.note: Two ink rows separated by a dashed accent rule — the divider is the star.

icons.name: Emoji
icons.note: The smiley lives in a cut-corner octagon face — instantly Frontier.

icons.name: Type
icons.note: T with cut serif ends.

icons.name: Change Case
icons.note: Big A + small a; the lowercase a is the accent layer.

icons.name: Spellcheck
icons.note: Word bars with an accent verification tick under the last word.

icons.name: Show Whitespace
icons.note: Pilcrow; the bowl is accent so toggled state is tintable.

icons.name: Text Size
icons.note: Small a and large A share a baseline; the delta is the accent arrow between.

icons.name: Align Left
icons.note: Ragged rows against an accent left rule.

icons.name: Align Center
icons.note: Centred rows with an accent axis.

icons.name: Align Right
icons.note: Mirror of Align Left.

icons.name: Shortcuts
icons.note: Key bed in the octagon frame with an accent spacebar.

icons.name: Zoom In
icons.note: Magnifier again, but octagon lens + accent plus/handle keeps it in-family.

icons.name: Zoom Out
icons.note: Mirror semantics of Zoom In.

icons.name: Zoom to Fit
icons.note: Four cut corner hooks closing around an accent content block — "fit" without a lens.

icons.name: Fullscreen
icons.note: Outward arrows; arrowheads are accent.

icons.name: Preview
icons.note: Eye whose iris is a cut-corner octagon — the family mark inside a universal shell.

icons.name: Hide Preview
icons.note: Eye with accent slash.

icons.name: Theme
icons.note: Half-tinted octagon = contrast dial; no sun/moon cliché.

icons.name: Light Mode
icons.note: Octagon core instead of a circle core; rays are accent.

icons.name: Dark Mode
icons.note: Crescent; inner edge is a cut chord rather than a pure arc.

icons.name: Go to Line
icons.note: Code rows with an accent pointer bracketing the destination row.

icons.name: Breadcrumb
icons.note: Path segments joined by a single accent chevron hinge.

icons.name: Symbol Outline
icons.note: Indented symbol bars; the active symbol is an accent square bullet.

icons.name: Minimap
icons.note: Narrow page of hairlines with an accent viewport frame sliding over it.

icons.name: Go to Definition
icons.note: An accent arrow diving into a bracket pair — destination is code.

icons.name: Find References
icons.note: Inverse of Go to Definition: arrow leaves the brackets toward three use-sites.

icons.name: History
icons.note: Clock face as a cut-corner octagon with accent hands.

icons.name: Refresh
icons.note: Circular arrow is universal; the head is accent and the arc stops short with square ends.

icons.name: Download
icons.note: Cut-corner tray + accent down arrow.

icons.name: Upload
icons.note: Mirror of Download.

icons.name: Open Externally
icons.note: Cut-corner box with accent escape arrow.

icons.name: Focus Editor
icons.note: Centre line stays bright while outer lines dim to ticks — focus by subtraction.

icons.name: Error
icons.note: Cut-corner octagon badge with accent x — no circle-slash cliché.

icons.name: Warning
icons.note: Warning triangle is universal; ours has cut base corners and an accent exclamation.

icons.name: Info
icons.note: Octagon badge with accent i.

icons.name: Hint
icons.note: Bulb with a cut-corner glass and accent filament rays.

icons.name: Breakpoint
icons.note: Gutter rule with a solid accent marker tag — exactly how breakpoints live in editors.

icons.name: Debug
icons.note: Chamfered play wedge plus a bug antenna pair — run + inspect in one glyph.

icons.name: Pause
icons.note: Twin accent bars with cut ends.

icons.name: Stop
icons.note: Accent cut-corner block.

icons.name: Step Over
icons.note: Arc over a node with accent landing arrow.

icons.name: Step Into
icons.note: Accent arrow descending into a cut bracket floor.

icons.name: Step Out
icons.note: Mirror of Step Into.

icons.name: Console
icons.note: Frame with prompt chevron and three log rows of decreasing weight.

icons.name: Stack Trace
icons.note: Stacked frames offset like falling cards; top frame is the accent active frame.

icons.name: Profile
icons.note: Flame silhouette with cut base; inner flame is accent.

icons.name: Watch
icons.note: Octagon eye-lid over an accent variable x — "watched value".

icons.name: Problems
icons.note: List rows each prefixed by a severity glyph: accent x, then wedge, then dot.

icons.name: Coverage
icons.note: A bar gauge: tinted filled portion against an ink outline track.

icons.name: Branch
icons.note: Branch graph is universal; nodes are Frontier hex-nodes instead of circles.

icons.name: Commit
icons.note: Line-node-line; the node is a hex-node.

icons.name: Merge
icons.note: Two rails converging into one hex-node.

icons.name: Compare
icons.note: Opposed transfer arrows between hex-nodes.

icons.name: Sync / Pull
icons.note: Accent arrow dropping a commit node onto a branch rail.

icons.name: Version History
icons.note: Rewind arrow wrapping a rail of three hex-nodes (oldest tinted).

icons.name: Tag
icons.note: Tag plate with cut point and accent eyelet.

icons.name: Repository
icons.note: Cut-corner folder carrying a branch rail with two hex-nodes.

icons.name: Commit List
icons.note: Vertical rail with alternating hex-nodes and message bars.

icons.name: Conflict
icons.note: Two commit arrows colliding head-on with an accent clash spark.

icons.name: Stash
icons.note: Three stacked plates with the top one lifted and tinted — changes set aside.

icons.name: Diff
icons.note: Split pane: accent plus on the new side, ink minus on the old.

icons.name: Assistant
icons.note: Four-ray concave spark with a satellite spark — the Frontier AI mark.

icons.name: Inline Suggestion
icons.note: Typed rows end in a ghost spark: the suggestion arrives mid-line.

icons.name: AI Chat
icons.note: Cut-corner speech bubble holding the spark.

icons.name: AI Refactor
icons.note: Spark inside a two-arrow cycle: intelligence applied around the code.

icons.name: Explain
icons.note: Spark above an open book of two ruled pages.

icons.name: AI Fix
icons.note: Spark fused to a wrench jaw — repair with intent.

icons.name: AI Changes
icons.note: Spark beside a plus/minus pair: machine-authored additions and removals.

icons.name: Agent
icons.note: Robot head in the octagon family with accent eyes and antenna spark.

icons.name: Chevron Down
icons.note: Plain chevron; universal primitive.

icons.name: Chevron Up
icons.note: Plain chevron; universal primitive.

icons.name: Chevron Left
icons.note: Plain chevron; universal primitive.

icons.name: Chevron Right
icons.note: Plain chevron; universal primitive.

icons.name: Arrow Left
icons.note: Plain arrow; universal primitive.

icons.name: Arrow Right
icons.note: Plain arrow; universal primitive.

icons.name: Arrow Up
icons.note: Plain arrow; universal primitive.

icons.name: Arrow Down
icons.note: Plain arrow; universal primitive.

icons.name: Check
icons.note: Plain tick; universal primitive.

icons.name: Close
icons.note: Plain cross; universal primitive.

icons.name: Plus
icons.note: Plain plus; universal primitive.

icons.name: Minus
icons.note: Plain minus; universal primitive.

icons.name: More
icons.note: Three accent squares instead of dots — family chamfer at micro scale.

icons.name: More Vertical
icons.note: Vertical twin of More.

icons.name: Drag Handle
icons.note: Six square grips.

icons.name: Settings
icons.note: Three slider rails with hex knobs at different offsets — no gear cliché.

icons.name: Notifications
icons.note: Bell with cut shoulders; clapper is accent.

icons.name: Favourite
icons.note: Five-point star with flattened top ray.

icons.name: Filter
icons.note: Funnel with cut rim corners.

icons.name: Sort
icons.note: Up/down arrow pair; down arrow is accent.

icons.name: Account
icons.note: Person with cut-corner head instead of circle head.

icons.name: Quick Action
icons.note: Bolt with cut waist.

icons.name: Flag
icons.note: Pennant with cut fly end.

icons.name: Trust
icons.note: Shield with cut top corners and accent check.

icons.name: Cloud Sync
icons.note: Cloud built from two cut lobes over a flat base.

icons.name: Status Dot
icons.note: The family octagon, empty — a status container.

icons.name: Modified Dot
icons.note: Solid accent hex-node: the "unsaved change" marker.

icons.name: Home
icons.note: House with cut eaves.
